summary: An iterator hands out values one at a time with next(). A generator function uses yield to build an iterator in a few lines, and makes each value only when it is asked for.
notes: yield start returns a value and pauses the function. The next call to next() continues from that line.
The Countdown class does the same job with __iter__ and __next__, and signals the end with raise StopIteration.
next(launch, "done") returns "done" instead of raising StopIteration when the generator is used up.
pitfall: A generator can only be looped over once. A second for loop over the same generator object runs zero times with no error.
